images.prompt: Two stacked ledger pages, centred with generous margin. The upper page, labelled TRANSCRIPT, shows a column of short text lines with one block struck through by a clean diagonal cross. The lower page, labelled KV CACHE, shows the same column with that block intact. To the right sits a small plain cube for the model, with thin arrows running from the cube to the intact block on the lower page and none to the upper page.

images.alt: A network diagram of connected nodes. Most nodes are solid; three are dashed outlines with dashed edges. A stack of pages on the left and a brain outline on the right each send an arrow into a solid node.
images.prompt: A graph of a dozen small nodes connected by edges, centred in the frame. Most nodes are filled solid; three nodes are drawn as empty dashed outlines, and the edges touching them are dashed too. To the left, a small stack of pages feeds a thin arrow into one filled node; to the right, a small brain-shaped outline feeds another arrow into a different filled node. The dashed nodes receive no arrows.

images.prompt: Four small labelled-free boxes in a row across the middle of the frame, each with a small tick mark stamped in its corner. Arrows link them left to right into a chain. Under the chain, a single long bracket spans all four boxes and ends in a small warning triangle. Everything sits well inside the frame.
